title: CausalEdge
description: A signed causal edge between two CausalHypothesis nodes. Polarity lives HERE and only here (positive|negative on the edge, direction-neutral text on the nodes). Hardened beyond the HOPE source model, which carries sign only: optional magnitude (weight), time structure (lagDays), and confidence — absent in the source and required for anything beyond a sales slide. Provenance invariant: warrantRefs is MANDATORY and non-empty — an unwarranted causal edge is inadmissible, which is what makes the graph scoreable by the provenance-fidelity eval. Self-loop invariant: fromRef must differ from toRef (family validator — JSON Schema cannot compare sibling values). Extraction provenance is digest-pinned so an edge is attributable to the exact extractor version that produced it.

specVersion.description: Epistemic-kernel contract version, pinned. Changing this const is a contract change.

graphRef.description: URN of the causal graph this edge belongs to. Invariant: both endpoints belong to the same graph.

toRef.description: Effect-side CausalHypothesis URN. Invariant: must differ from fromRef (validator-enforced).

sign.description: Causal polarity. The ONLY place direction lives.

weight.description: Optional effect magnitude in [0,1]; sign is carried separately so magnitude stays non-negative.

lagDays.description: Optional causal lag in days between cause and observable effect.

confidence.description: Optional confidence in the edge's existence, distinct from its magnitude.

items.description: URN of a warrant/evidence artifact (e.g. an EvidenceAtom) supporting this causal link.

warrantRefs.description: Mandatory, non-empty warrants. No unprovenance'd causality enters the graph.

extractorRef.description: URN or stable reference of the extraction pipeline that proposed this edge.

extractorDigest.description: Content digest of the exact extractor version.

extractor.description: Digest-pinned extraction provenance for machine-proposed edges; omitted for human-authored edges.
